decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The application for the erection of a replacement garden shed, as shown on drawing numbers 1, 2 and 3, received 03 February 2006, is recommended for approval as it is considered that the garden shed by reason of its size, materials and design would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 32 Marlborough Road, Chiswick. The conservatory would preserve the character of the Wellesley Road Conservation Area and would not be detrimental to the surrounding properties. The development is in accordance with the London Borough of Hounslow's Unitary Development Plan (2003) and is compliant with Councils residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Replacement of existing shed by a larger garden shed in rear garden to house
